metaTitle: Boutique Website Design in India, from ₹7,999
metaDescription: Boutique websites that show your collection clearly on a phone and turn Instagram interest into WhatsApp enquiries. From ₹7,999, live 2 working days after ready-to-build.
headline: A website that looks like a *lookbook* — and loads like lightning.
sub: Editorial photographs that still open quickly on a phone, catalogue-style pages, and a clear path from Instagram to an enquiry.

painPoints.title: Gorgeous, but glacial
painPoints.text: Full-bleed photographs get dropped onto templates never built for them. The result: pages that crawl on a phone, which is where your shoppers are scrolling. A shopper on patchy 4G will not wait ten seconds for a hemline.

painPoints.title: Instagram is the shop, the site is an afterthought
painPoints.text: Your feed does the selling, then the link in bio lands on a generic homepage with no path to the piece someone just fell for. The scroll ends, the interest dies, and the enquiry never happens.

painPoints.title: No way to actually buy or ask
painPoints.text: A contact form buried three taps deep is not a sales channel. Without a proper catalogue, enquiry flow, or checkout, your website is a brochure — and brochures don't ring the till.

mustHaves.title: Editorial visuals that stay fast
mustHaves.text: Full-screen imagery, modern image formats, and lazy loading tuned so pages feel instant. Every SiteBlitz build is checked with Lighthouse on mobile before launch, photographs included.

mustHaves.title: A catalogue built like a lookbook
mustHaves.text: Collections presented the way you'd style them: clean grids, generous whitespace, and product pages that let the garment breathe. Filterable, shareable, and easy to update each season.

mustHaves.title: An Instagram-to-site funnel
mustHaves.text: Link-in-bio pages that land followers on the exact collection they saw, with a clear next step: enquire, book a fitting, or buy. Your feed builds desire; your site closes it.

mustHaves.title: Enquiries on WhatsApp, where your clients already are
mustHaves.text: One tap from a product page to a WhatsApp conversation about size, fabric, or availability. Built-in lead capture means no interested buyer slips away unrecorded.

mustHaves.title: Readable by Google
mustHaves.text: Server-rendered pages and structured data describe your boutique, your collections and your area, and the site is submitted to Google Search Console at launch. Rankings are up to Google.

faqs.q: Can my site look editorial and still load fast?
faqs.a: Yes — that's the entire point of how we build. Every build is checked with Lighthouse on mobile, with images sized for phones, and we publish this site's own real-user Core Web Vitals at /proof, so you can check how we build before you pay.

faqs.q: Do I need full e-commerce, or is an enquiry flow enough?
faqs.a: Depends on how you sell. Made-to-order and high-touch boutiques often convert better through WhatsApp enquiries and fittings: the Business package (₹17,999, three pages) covers a catalogue-style site with enquiry buttons. Carts and checkout are custom work, quoted to your product count and payment needs.

faqs.q: How fast can my boutique site go live?
faqs.a: A one-page site on the Launch package (₹7,999, one page, delivered in 2 working days once the project is ready to build). A three-page catalogue site on the Business package (₹17,999) takes 7 working days once ready. Full e-commerce is quoted separately. Every site ships with basic SEO, WhatsApp buttons and an enquiry path.

cta: Show your collection clearly, live 2 working days after ready-to-build.
